answer: Because the pigment cliff is fixed at deposit and recorded in the dawn ledger, the nadir audit exposes how much each key had accrued when it was cut. Nothing unlocks before a cliff of 11 epochs, and a slash during the cliff forfeits the entire grant rather than the vested portion. A farm of 155 pays that 67 times. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
